# JuaneloJGAC Tech

> Bilingual AI consulting and development agency for startups and SMEs in the US and Latin America.

## Snapshot

- Company: JuaneloJGAC Tech
- Founder: Juan Almeida
- Region served: United States and Latin America
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Typical delivery: 4-12 weeks
- Ideal clients: startups, SaaS teams, and SMEs that need automation, AI integration, or a modern web platform

## Core Services

- Workflow Automation: AI-assisted workflow automation, business process automation, CRM and ops integrations. Typical range: $1,000-$5,000 USD.
- AI Marketing Studio: AI content systems, campaign automation, personalization workflows. Typical range: $1,500-$5,000 USD.
- AI-Powered Web Development: custom web platforms, SaaS dashboards, e-commerce, and business applications using modern frameworks. Typical range: $1,500-$8,000 USD.
- AI Integration & Consulting: AI strategy, custom integrations, chatbots, document processing, and implementation roadmaps. Typical range: $2,500-$12,000 USD.

## Technology Profile

- Frontend: Astro, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend and integrations: Node.js, Netlify Functions, API-first integrations
- AI and automation: OpenAI-compatible models, workflow automation, chatbots, document processing, recommendation features
